generationOrder.title: Fracht und Transport
generationOrder.prompt:
Create ONE polished 16:9 first-person Hestia game-screen DESIGN CONCEPT, not a website, comparison board or implemented gameplay screenshot. The FIRST attached image is the OWNER-APPROVED visual reference. Continue its exact design family: bright hard-edged, finely stepped axis-aligned MICROVOXEL limestone coast, turquoise water, cubic plants, dark structural machine frames, warm ivory ceramic panels and petrol/teal functional parts. Keep the tangible fine hard voxel geometry from that image throughout machines AND world; avoid rounded clay, smooth terrain, photoreal generic machinery, gigantic cubes or a replacement art direction. Match its authored industrial game UI: warm ivory surfaces, dark charcoal text/icons, petrol-blue primary action, quiet amber warning accents, thin dividers, small cut corners, purposeful readable hierarchy. A compact contextual instrument belongs LOWER RIGHT, the current goal UPPER LEFT, quiet compass upper center, subtle center reticle and key hints bottom left. The dominant center/left remains a playable world; no tabbar spanning the image, inventory tile grid, KPI-card dashboard, randomly floating info boxes or helmet frame.

MANDATORY: the small known-world MINIMAP is UPPER RIGHT, visibly separated from the contextual panel. Same ivory frame and visual scale as approved reference, north label, player triangle, one known footpath, stranded wreck, own installed assets only where relevant, and legible 20 m scale. No bottom-left or duplicate map; no arbitrary radar contacts, global satellite knowledge or future city. Supported input is PC mouse/keyboard; typography must be readable at a 1280x720 presentation, with strong dark-on-ivory contrast and no tiny body text. A screen may have fewer words to preserve legibility. Show ONE primary action with immediate understandable context. Pause/preview/actual state distinctions must be truthful within the illustrative scene. A discreet small 'ENTWURF' label identifies this as a concept. Exact amounts below are frozen existing recipe/BOM data, not new balance changes. Do not draw XP, life bars, oxygen, research locks, fluid systems, mining rigs or a flying ship.

SECONDARY attached real browser captures supply existing content/flow only. Their old dark webpage-like panels and huge repeated button lists are the specific design problem, NEVER copy their visual treatment. This is a continuation of the approved first image, NOT a variant of its palette. All existing machines/assets should share a coherent factory-theme appearance rather than unrelated individual skins.

SCREEN 1 — FINITE WRECK CARGO / PREPARING HEAVY TRANSPORT. First-person view beside reachable wreck cargo. Center-left shows a physically grounded rectangular heavy carrier frame with recognizable rigid container silhouette, dark frame, ivory side plates, teal braces and small safety marks. THIRD reference provides the carrier's basic rectangular container silhouette; it is not a wheeled vehicle, giant forklift or robot. Cargo packs sit nearby; the permanently stranded small wreck is a quiet background landmark, never flight-ready. Do not reuse the big Cutter center silhouette from the approved HUD; we are at the cargo pickup location now.

Upper-left goal: 'Umform-Bausatz zum Bauplatz bringen'. Lower-right use one coherent ~380px wide compact cargo instrument at intended1280px width, slightly taller than machine reference only if content needs it, clear center/left view. Title 'Fracht & Transport' with crate icon and simple close/back control. Small understated 'Sitzung pausiert' line because the inventory overlay pauses. 'Wrackfracht' and 'Verfügbar 2.984,4 kg' are a total of all finite cargo; the displayed subset is not the whole manifest. A short purposeful list, max four realistic rows with small hard-voxel asset icons: 'Umform-Bausatz 341 kg' SELECTED, 'Zuschnitt-Bausatz 208 kg', 'Expeditionsakku 50 kg', 'Feldkabel 40 m'. Selected package gets a single warm thin outline or petrol indicator, not a giant unrelated card. A small isometric voxel package/carrier diagram clarifies Wrack -> Träger; no magic inventory cloud. Under the selected row show 'Umform-Bausatz' and bold '341 kg', source 'Wrack', receiving carrier 'Leer'. This is before pickup; do not simultaneously label the carrier carrying341kg or deployed Former. One clear PETROL button 'Bausatz aufnehmen'. Small secondary 'Alle Fracht' may open remaining manifest; no dropdown wall or six-feature tabs. Footer key hints 'Esc Zurück', 'M Karte'. The player should immediately understand which finite heavy package is selected, its mass, where it goes, and that pickup is the next action. Keep the cargo overlay airy but compact, minimal prose.
